leadText:
Will is the Japanese opening theme for the Terastal Debut arc and the third of Pokémon Horizons: The Series. It debuted in HZ046, replacing Halo. The full version of the song was first released as a digital single on April 12, 2024. 

A Korean version of the song, titled Will -Korean ver.-, is the opening theme for the Korean dub the Terastal Debut arc and second of Pokémon Horizons: The Series. It debuted in HZ046, replacing We Go. The full version of the song was first released as a digital single on October 15, 2024. The Korean version of the song is also used as the opening theme for the Asian English release and the Thai and Hong Kong Cantonese dubs of Pokémon Horizons: Season 2—The Search for Laqua, debuting in Welcome to Naranja Academy! and replacing We Go (English Ver.).

Will is the Japanese opening theme for the Terastal Debut arc and the third of Pokémon Horizons: The Series. It debuted in HZ046, replacing Halo. The full version of the song was first released as a digital single on April 12, 2024. 

A Korean version of the song, titled Will -Korean ver.-, is the opening theme for the Korean dub the Terastal Debut arc and second of Pokémon Horizons: The Series. It debuted in HZ046, replacing We Go. The full version of the song was first released as a digital single on October 15, 2024. The Korean version of the song is also used as the opening theme for the Asian English release and the Thai and Hong Kong Cantonese dubs of Pokémon Horizons: Season 2—The Search for Laqua, debuting in Welcome to Naranja Academy! and replacing We Go (English Ver.).

==Opening animation==
===Synopsis===
Liko and walk out the gates together before a shot of her greeting the viewers occurs. She is seen holding a Poké Ball before a shot of Roy greeting the viewers occurs. Roy is seen walking with , along with Dot and before a shot of Dot greeting the viewers occurs.

Roy runs ahead of Liko and Dot as an jumps out of the river next to them. The three kids and all their Pokémon are enjoying sandwiches by a campfire at night. The next scene shows them walking through a snowstorm. As they lay down happily on the grass, a next shot shows various Paldean Pokémon behind the trees before a appears. A singalong shot occurs with Ann and Nemona on the bench closest to the camera, Liko in the middle behind them, Dot and Penny on the left, and Roy on the right. On the beat, and jump in front of the camera, followed by , and . After that plays a scene with Captain Pikachu and Friede.

Liko, Roy and Dot look out at the sunset together, ready for what lies ahead. The next shot shows Sidian and , along with Coral and . Three Tera symbols glowing green, red and blue appear before turning into Tera crystals. Liko charges her Tera Orb, along with Roy and Dot. Floragato Terastallizes into a Tera type, along with Fuecoco and Quaxly, who Terastallize into a Tera type and a Tera type respectively. The next shot shows Jacq, Clavell, Geeta, Dendra and Chalce. As Liko, Roy and Dot run across the grass, transitions of Gym Leaders and Elite Four members occur in this order: Katy and , Brassius and , Iono and , Kofu and , Tulip and , Ryme and , Grusha and , Larry and and , Hassel and , Poppy and , and Rika and .

Liko is about to take a bite of her sandwich before Floragato snatches it. After the camera focuses on Liko's eye, which becomes crystalized, the kids overlook a hill. Multiple Poké Balls are thrown in the air and become the title logo, and it concludes with Captain Pikachu winking while giving a thumbs up while smiling.

==Trivia ==
This is the first Japanese opening theme song of the mainline Pokémon animated series to be sung by a non-Japanese artist, as it was sung by a Korean girl group.
This is the first Korean opening theme song of the mainline animated series to have been translated directly from Japanese.
By extension, this is also the first English opening theme song of the mainline animated series to have been translated directly from Japanese, as the Korean version of the song is used in the Asian English release.
This also makes it the first English opening theme where a majority of the lyrics are in another language.

sections.heading: Lead
sections.text:
Will is the Japanese opening theme for the Terastal Debut arc and the third of Pokémon Horizons: The Series. It debuted in HZ046, replacing Halo. The full version of the song was first released as a digital single on April 12, 2024. 

A Korean version of the song, titled Will -Korean ver.-, is the opening theme for the Korean dub the Terastal Debut arc and second of Pokémon Horizons: The Series. It debuted in HZ046, replacing We Go. The full version of the song was first released as a digital single on October 15, 2024. The Korean version of the song is also used as the opening theme for the Asian English release and the Thai and Hong Kong Cantonese dubs of Pokémon Horizons: Season 2—The Search for Laqua, debuting in Welcome to Naranja Academy! and replacing We Go (English Ver.).

sections.heading: Synopsis
sections.text:
Liko and walk out the gates together before a shot of her greeting the viewers occurs. She is seen holding a Poké Ball before a shot of Roy greeting the viewers occurs. Roy is seen walking with , along with Dot and before a shot of Dot greeting the viewers occurs.

Roy runs ahead of Liko and Dot as an jumps out of the river next to them. The three kids and all their Pokémon are enjoying sandwiches by a campfire at night. The next scene shows them walking through a snowstorm. As they lay down happily on the grass, a next shot shows various Paldean Pokémon behind the trees before a appears. A singalong shot occurs with Ann and Nemona on the bench closest to the camera, Liko in the middle behind them, Dot and Penny on the left, and Roy on the right. On the beat, and jump in front of the camera, followed by , and . After that plays a scene with Captain Pikachu and Friede.

Liko, Roy and Dot look out at the sunset together, ready for what lies ahead. The next shot shows Sidian and , along with Coral and . Three Tera symbols glowing green, red and blue appear before turning into Tera crystals. Liko charges her Tera Orb, along with Roy and Dot. Floragato Terastallizes into a Tera type, along with Fuecoco and Quaxly, who Terastallize into a Tera type and a Tera type respectively. The next shot shows Jacq, Clavell, Geeta, Dendra and Chalce. As Liko, Roy and Dot run across the grass, transitions of Gym Leaders and Elite Four members occur in this order: Katy and , Brassius and , Iono and , Kofu and , Tulip and , Ryme and , Grusha and , Larry and and , Hassel and , Poppy and , and Rika and .

Liko is about to take a bite of her sandwich before Floragato snatches it. After the camera focuses on Liko's eye, which becomes crystalized, the kids overlook a hill. Multiple Poké Balls are thrown in the air and become the title logo, and it concludes with Captain Pikachu winking while giving a thumbs up while smiling.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
This is the first Japanese opening theme song of the mainline Pokémon animated series to be sung by a non-Japanese artist, as it was sung by a Korean girl group.
This is the first Korean opening theme song of the mainline animated series to have been translated directly from Japanese.
By extension, this is also the first English opening theme song of the mainline animated series to have been translated directly from Japanese, as the Korean version of the song is used in the Asian English release.
This also makes it the first English opening theme where a majority of the lyrics are in another language.

aiReadySummary.title: Will (song)
aiReadySummary.searchableText:
Will (song)
Category:Korean opening themes
Will is the Japanese opening theme for the Terastal Debut arc and the third of Pokémon Horizons: The Series. It debuted in HZ046, replacing Halo. The full version of the song was first released as a digital single on April 12, 2024. 

A Korean version of the song, titled Will -Korean ver.-, is the opening theme for the Korean dub the Terastal Debut arc and second of Pokémon Horizons: The Series. It debuted in HZ046, replacing We Go. The full version of the song was first released as a digital single on October 15, 2024. The Korean version of the song is also used as the opening theme for the Asian English release and the Thai and Hong Kong Cantonese dubs of Pokémon Horizons: Season 2—The Search for Laqua, debuting in Welcome to Naranja Academy! and replacing We Go (English Ver.).
